gold_sql:
SELECT p.*, elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-94.383608 45.979142)',4326)::geography, 3900)
  AND p.leisure = 'park'
  AND elev.z >= 80;

```sql
WITH zoo_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-94.383608, 45.979142), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
buffered_area AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(geom, 3900) AS geom
  FROM zoo_geom
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM buffered_area))
),
elevation_filter AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Union(rast), 1)).geom AS geom
  FROM dem_clip
  WHERE (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Union(rast), 1)).val >= 80
),
park_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-86.964261, 36.076845), 4326)::geography AS geom
)
SELECT 
  'Harpeth River State Park Coley Davis Access' AS park_name,
  ST_Distance((SELECT geom FROM buffered_area), (SELECT geom FROM park_geom)) < 3900 AS within_distance,
  (SELECT val FROM ST_SummaryStats(ST_Union(rast), 1) WHERE val >= 80) AS elevation_status
FROM dem_clip;
```
